description: Find childcare centers, school-age (after-school) programs, camps and youth programs listed in BackPR's program finder, which uses official state and local licensing data. Search one state by city or 5-digit ZIP code (ZIP wins if both are given), optionally by program type. Returns up to 25 active listings with name, type, city, ZIP, ages, capacity and phone where published. Each answer links to the backpr.com finder page and names the data sources and their licenses. Home-based family childcare is never listed. A listing isn't an endorsement.

city.description: City name, such as "Austin". "St." and "Saint" match the same city.

limit.description: How many listings to return, 1 to 25 (default 10).

state.description: US state name or 2-letter code, case-insensitive, such as "Texas" or "TX". "DC" also works.

type.description: "center" (childcare center), "school-age" (before- and after-school programs), "camp" or "youth-program". Omit for all types.

name: find_programs

finder_url.description: The backpr.com finder page for this program's city

search.description: What the listings were matched on

source_url.description: The most specific backpr.com finder page for this search

top_cities.description: Cities with the most listings, to narrow a search

title: Find licensed youth programs
